literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe the same construct: a C-terminal V5 tag appended after the stop codon of KIR2DS4, i.e., after residue 304 (A). KIR2DS4 topology places residues 267–304 in the intracellular domain; the C-terminus is therefore cytoplasmic. L2 explicitly states that 'detection of the C-terminal V5 tags measured total KIR protein expression', confirming the V5 tag is used for intracellular/total-protein detection, while surface staining relied on a KIR2DS4-specific mAb against the extracellular domain. No ledger line reports a tag insertion on the extracellular face (residues 22–245) of this protein. Zero extracellular sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal V5 tag appended after residue 304 (A, last residue); the C-terminus of KIR2DS4 is intracellular (residues 267–304), so this tag faces the cytoplasm and is used for total-protein detection, not surface labelling (L2).
